{
  "sop_id": "SOP-015",
  "title": "Invoice verification",
  "steps": [
    {"step_id": "S1", "name": "Create ticket and assign to self", "role": "Executor", "type": "intake"},
    {"step_id": "S2", "name": "Check vendor GSTIN and PAN, and for duplicates", "role": "Executor", "type": "work"},
    {"step_id": "S3", "name": "Three-way match: invoice vs PO vs GRN", "role": "Executor", "type": "work"},
    {"step_id": "S4", "name": "Calculate GST input credit and TDS", "role": "Executor", "type": "work"},
    {"step_id": "S5", "name": "Knock off advances or other deductions", "role": "Executor", "type": "work"},
    {"step_id": "S6", "name": "Prepare payment voucher", "role": "Executor", "type": "work"},
    {"step_id": "S7", "name": "Submit payment voucher", "role": "Executor", "type": "work"},
    {"step_id": "D1", "name": "Wait for GRN or completion certificate from Stores or Operations", "role": "Executor", "type": "decision"},
    {"step_id": "S8", "name": "Mark ticket DependencyWait", "role": "Executor", "type": "work"},
    {"step_id": "A1", "name": "Incharge verification and approval", "role": "Incharge", "type": "approval"},
    {"step_id": "A2", "name": "Lead approval (if invoice outside tolerance or above 10 lakh)", "role": "Lead", "type": "approval"},
    {"step_id": "R1", "name": "Correct and resubmit after rejection", "role": "Executor", "type": "rework"},
    {"step_id": "R2", "name": "Escalate to Lead after second rejection", "role": "Lead", "type": "decision"}
  ],
  "approvals": [
    {"stage": "Incharge", "condition": "always"},
    {"stage": "Lead", "condition": "invoice outside tolerance or above 10 lakh"}
  ],
  "dependencies": [
    {"dep_id": "D1", "provider": "Stores or Operations", "item": "GRN or completion certificate", "parallel_group": "P1"}
  ],
  "rework_reasons": ["Amount mismatch", "Wrong quantity", "Incorrect category", "Required document missing"],
  "first_pass_yield_target": 0.9
}
